title: Dawa.ug
subtitle: Ugandan e-commerce marketplace
description: A buy-and-sell marketplace for Uganda — a trusted platform for e-commerce with product listings, wishlists, messaging, and user profiles. Built to serve the Ugandan market with local payment considerations.
problem: Ugandan buyers and sellers lack a dedicated, trustworthy platform for e-commerce. Existing options are either too complex, not localized, or lack proper safety features for peer-to-peer transactions.
role: Built the full marketplace platform including product listing and search, user authentication and profiles, wishlist functionality, messaging system, and the responsive frontend optimized for mobile users.
approach: Full-stack marketplace application with product CRUD, search and filtering, user authentication, real-time messaging between buyers and sellers, and responsive design optimized for mobile-first usage patterns common in Uganda.
hardestDecision: Building trust features — implementing safety tips, secure meeting location suggestions, and verification systems without adding friction that would discourage adoption in a market where simplicity drives usage.
outcome: Live at dawa.ug with product listings, user accounts, and messaging functionality.
whatIdChange: Would integrate mobile money payment escrow, add location-based search for local pickups, and implement a rating/review system for buyer-seller trust.
